messages.author: 88939e8ba00ead97
messages.subject: Error: cannot open the connection
parts:
Hi! I am new to Shiny and am trying to deploy my first app. I have come across an error. My app works just fine in R studio, when I go to deploy it seems to deploy successfully, however, when the web page opens it brings up the error cannot open the connection.

My code is pasted below. I would appreciate any help to get this resolved as I really like what Shiny can do and would like to share my data with others in my organisation.

require(shiny)
require(rsco)
meanweights <- read.csv("meanweights.csv")
ui <- fluidPage(
  selectInput(inputId = "statesel",
              label="Choose a state",
              choices = sort(unique(meanweights$state)),
              selected = "VIC",
              multiple = FALSE),
  plotOutput("lineplot")
)
# Define server logic required to draw a histogram
server <- function(input, output) {
  output$lineplot <- renderPlot({
    read.csv("meanweights.csv") %>%
      filter(state == input$statesel) %>%
      ggplot(aes(day, mean_weight, color=property_type))+
      geom_line()+theme_bw(base_size = 14)
  })
}
# Run the application
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

Thanks.
